title: Confirm whether production stella applies the instruct prompt
description: stella400m defaults to PROMPT_MODE=always, which prepends the Stella instruct prompt server-side. Stella is asymmetric, so this changes the vector: query-side and passage-side embeddings are not comparable. If the employer service encodes without a prompt, this deployment is not reproducing production and the sweep numbers are for a slightly different workload. Needs a one-line answer from someone with access to the production encode path. If the answer is 'no prompt', flip PROMPT_MODE to never in config.pbtxt and re-run the sweep (triton-throughput-tester-6fx) so both changes land together.

title: Wire stella400m into a 400M-scale intent pipeline
description: stella400m is only the encoder half. To reproduce the production intent shape at 400M, add a second config entry pointing at the same checkpoint directory with PROMPT_MODE=never (corpus indexing must NOT get the instruct prompt -- Stella is asymmetric and prompting both sides collapses every similarity into 0.96-0.9999), then have the retrieval step score the corpus with the corpus-side model and the query with the query-side model. Open question still unanswered by the user: does production return the corpus string, the intent label, or both? Also decide whether configuration.py and modeling.py should be vendored into triton-models/stella400m/1/ so the deployment is rebuildable from the repo alone; they are currently remote-only.
close_reason: Premise was wrong. User confirmed production stella is a pure embedding service: it returns embeddings and does no cosine similarity and involves no corpus. There is no 400M intent pipeline to build on top of this model. Both open questions in the description are now resolved: (1) retrieval is out of scope for stella400m entirely, (2) configuration.py/modeling.py and the rest of the checkpoint metadata are now vendored into triton-models/stella400m/1/, so the deployment is rebuildable from the repo (only model.safetensors is downloaded).

title: Re-run stella sweep wired on the 1 Gb switch
description: All stella numbers were taken over slow wifi ssh, so absolute rps is not trustworthy: the ic1 rows are flat at ~110 rps across three different configs, which is the signature of a client-side ceiling. The ic2/ic4 gains ARE real because GPU sm moved 35% -> 82% alongside them, which a client limit cannot cause. Re-run from the box: ROWS='base:off:1:1 ic1:on:1:16 ic2:on:2:16 ic4:on:4:16 ic4_deep:on:4:64' bash /tmp/sweep.sh 30, plus a client-side ramp-up.py run. Confirm the ic4 knee holds and check whether ic6/ic8 continue the curve. Measure the noise floor properly.

title: Sweep query length and corpus size on intent-replica
description: Batching and CPU-vs-GPU cosine are now measured (see git log 91dffa9): batching dominates, worth 5.3x over the production shape. Remaining axes: (1) query token length 10-25 - the encoder is now the ceiling at 52% GPU sm, so this is the highest-value remaining sweep; (2) corpus size - try build_corpus.py --limit 8000/16000 to see how rps scales, which isolates the bandwidth cost; (3) max_queue_delay_microseconds (currently 5000) - at conc=64 batches reached 28 rows, a longer delay may reach max_batch_size 128; (4) max_batch_size 128 vs 64. Use tools/measure.sh which reports req_per_exec and GPU sm together.

value: nvidia-smi dmon -s um columns are: gpu sm mem enc dec jpg ofa fb bar1 ccpm (sm=$2, mem=$3, fb=$8), header is 2 lines. awk compares strings unless you write $2+0, which silently makes every max wrong. Real Triton batch size = delta nv_inference_request_success / delta nv_inference_exec_count, scoped to the gpu_uuid= variant of the metric.

Triton model repo is bind-mounted host /AI/models/triton -> container /opt/ml/model, so model files are at /opt/ml/model/<model>/<version>/. Never sed a container path from the host: it fails silently and yields uniformly wrong measurements. Confirm the LOADED config with GET :8000/v2/models/<name>/config, not the file.

git push over HTTPS fails here (no credential helper). Push with: git push git@github.com:jdchmiel/triton-throughput-learning.git main. Do NOT run bd dolt push - this repo has no Dolt remote and needs none; the pre-commit hook exports beads into the git-tracked .beads/issues.jsonl, so git push is the only sync step. See AGENTS.md 'Beads Sync Model'.
